keyed.HH.Setting.core.music.Desc: Our three calm songs (one for spring and summer days, one for autumn, one for winter) join the normal RimWorld playlist. When hosting: only in colonies that use Hearth & Harbor (a guest bed, a venue sign or a bank account).
keyed.HH.Setting.core.musicShare: How often our songs come up
keyed.HH.Setting.core.musicShare.Desc: Weight of our songs in the playlist compared with one vanilla song. 1 = like any other song of the season, 0 = never.
keyed.HH.Setting.core.lifeFx.Desc: Small signs and sounds for the moments of a stay: a chime when guests arrive, the desk bell at check-in, coins when they pay or tip, a wave and their review in stars when they leave, a heart for couples sharing a bed.
keyed.HH.Setting.core.creatorPawn: The author may wander the rim
keyed.HH.Setting.core.creatorPawn.Desc: Like the creator pawns of the base game, Hearth & Harbor's author can turn up now and then as a generated pawn: a kind, hard-working wandering innkeeper.
keyed.HH.Story.SuggestsTip: Click to use the hosting difficulty this storyteller suggests. You can still change it with the button.
